name: Kex Template
_comment: ERB-shaped templates (kexhq/kex#171): `<% %>`-delimited holes of real Kex, scanned by Template.scan and lowered to a real function by Template.text/.html. The true extension sits before .ket (README.md.ket), so everything outside a tag is left as plain content rather than guessed at. Ported to Vim syntax in editors/vim/syntax/ket.vim — keep the two in sync.

comment.comment: <%# ... %> — never highlighted as code, unlike every other tag below.
comment.name: comment.block.ket

interpolateRaw.comment: <%== ... %> — interpolate without auto-escaping. Listed before #interpolate so the second `=` is never left dangling as code.

control.comment: <% ... %> / <%- ... -%> — a Kex control region (if/match arms, block bodies, let); the leading `-` trims the tag's own indent, the trailing one the newline after it. The negative lookahead keeps this from swallowing the three tags above.

literal.comment: <%% — a literal `<%` in the output, for a template that itself generates ERB-shaped text. Never a tag.
literal.name: constant.character.escape.ket
